note: Canonical NUDIMMUD design memory. Skill-local copies are compatibility mirrors; write new decisions here first.

entries.decision: Plus icon bottom-left (file picker), textarea center, model select, reasoning level button, mic button, send button. All 34px height for alignment.
entries.pattern: Unified chat bar pattern — replicate across any agent interface

entries.decision: Three-column layout: 88px tab rail left, flex-1 center with orbs + chat, collapsible terminal pane at bottom. Avoids scattered tool UIs.
entries.pattern: Tab rail left + content right + collapsible bottom — reuse for any multi-tool page

entries.decision: Circular orbs (68px) with animated orbit ring, hover scale + glow. Arranged in flex-wrap grid. Type-coded: cyan=skill, gold=tool, red=danger. Tooltip on hover.
entries.pattern: Orb cluster — use for any tool/capability catalog display

entries.decision: 32x32 base SVG, cuneiform tablet motif, circuit trace overlay. Cyan/gold on void. Scanline overlay animation, glitch on hover. No rounded corners.
entries.pattern: Pixel art sigil — repeat grid-based SVG approach for any icon in the HUD

entries.decision: Dual bar (session + weekly) in footer. Bar turns gold >55%, red >80%. Monospace token counts with up/down arrows. Cost in gold. Polls every 5s.
entries.pattern: Dual-metric status bar — reuse for any live telemetry display

entries.decision: Collapsible dropdowns per provider (KIE primary expanded, remote collapsed). Model pills for selection. Generate button inline with prompt. Results grid below.
entries.pattern: Layered provider dropdown — KIE first, remote second, always same pattern

entries.decision: Replaced flat header+pill-nav layout with VSCode spatial grammar: activity-bar (48px, col 1) | sidebar/explorer (220px, col 2) | editor-area (flex col: title-bar + tab-bar + breadcrumb + content, col 3) + status-bar (22px, row 2, full width). Grid: `var(--vsc-activity-w) var(--sidebar-w) 1fr / 1fr var(--vsc-status-h)`. Nav nodes moved from inline pill tabs to vertical list items in sidebar with left-border active indicator. Status bar background uses `rgba(0,100,160,0.92)` (VSCode blue adapted to HUD opacity model). All existing JS IDs preserved (`#module-content`, `#sidebar-nav`, `.nav-node[data-module]`, all footer IDs). MutationObserver inline script syncs tab-bar and breadcrumb with active nav-node class changes.
entries.pattern: VSCode layout shell: grid(activity | sidebar | editor / content | statusbar). Editor area = flex-col with title-bar, tab-bar, breadcrumb, scrollable content. Activity bar = icon-only with left-border active state. Sidebar = vertical nav list with grouped sections + dividers. Status bar = 22px full-width strip.

entries.decision: Added route reset for SPA navigation, replaced bloom cursor with a precise sigil reticle, and layered hermetic line art plus route constellation navigation across all pages.
entries.pattern: Use a global crimson-only hermetic veil for visual storytelling, with per-route symbols and nonblocking page-sequence guidance.

entries.decision: Integrated the real Nexus Link SVG logo assets from 05_NEXUS-LINK/Identity/NLP LOGO as a first-load animated lockup, scroll-reactive background mark, ghost elements, construction lines, and navigation wordmark. Added hard CSS override so data-magnetic elements cannot be translated by stale cursor behavior.
entries.pattern: Brand mark as atmosphere: first-load lockup resolves into scroll-reactive background construction system.

entries.decision: Replaced route exit-wait with immediate route rendering, made the cursor visual-only with hover brackets and no DOM transform mutation, and expanded the visual system into a route/scroll-reactive board of nodes, edges, move counters, animated guide paths, and floating concept-art glyphs.
entries.pattern: Chaotic systematic site layer: route equals board state, scroll equals move progression, visual edges reveal relationships without moving clickable UI.

entries.decision: Rebuilt Nexus Link Productions as a crimson-only spatial room: fixed perspective floor grid, pulsing triquetra vanishing point, floating Z-depth panels, magnetic tilt, bento work grid, compact services stations, CV-driven about narrative, and multi-step contact flow.
entries.pattern: Crimson-only architectural depth system for premium brand-content pages; no green, cyan, teal, or purple accents.

entries.component: ExeoFlow + YURI OS future-session pack manifest
entries.decision: Added a start-here manifest and a benchmark delta sheet to the design pack so future sessions can load the right files in the right order without re-discovering the pack structure. This makes the baseline faster to reuse and clearer to improve.
entries.pattern: Future-session reference pack: explicit load order, source-of-truth pointer, benchmark delta, and guardrails.

entries.decision: Created a reusable agent skill for the ExeoFlow + YURI OS design reference workflow so future sessions can load the pack structure, benchmark comparison, and guardrails directly from a skill instead of reconstructing the process from scratch.
entries.pattern: Portable skill + design pack + benchmark companion + manifest + delta sheet.

entries.component: ExeoFlow YURI OS consumer briefing website
entries.decision: Replaced the overloaded futuristic HUD with a Nexus Link-style consumer website: fixed glass navigation, cinematic hero, guided usage section, three-stage commercial path, card-based target explorer, portfolio fit map, evidence board, and send-package close. The design prioritizes reading order, progressive disclosure, and client comprehension over dense operator visuals.
entries.pattern: Consumer briefing site: hero story -> usage guide -> commercial path -> interactive account explorer -> portfolio lens -> evidence board -> package close.

entries.component: ExeoFlow YURI OS interactive business displays
entries.decision: Converted the vertical activity rail from decorative labels into clickable mode controls and added four inspectable business views: account operating diagram, portfolio fit scatter, source evidence board, and business motion board. This gives Claudio both account intelligence and a meeting-ready sales motion.
entries.pattern: Mode rail HUD: ACC/FIT/SRC/OPS buttons switch a central business display while preserving the selected-account dossier, right-side buying-center context, and bottom matrix.

entries.component: ExeoFlow YURI OS real-world SITREP map
entries.decision: Replaced the abstract location tracker with a Leaflet real-world map using OpenStreetMap/CARTO dark tiles. Added pan, scroll zoom, native zoom controls, country focus buttons, selected-target focus, clickable numbered markers, and popups while preserving the Nexus Link consumer-site shell.
entries.pattern: Leaflet SITREP map: real map tiles + custom numbered div markers + focus pills + selected account side panel.

entries.component: ExeoFlow YURI OS SITREP baseline reference pack
entries.decision: Saved the current ExeoFlow + YURI OS SITREP website as an internal design-source pack under 03_RESOURCES/References/design-packs. The pack records this as a basic baseline and includes snapshot assets, design notes, a reuse guide, and a prioritized improvement backlog for future presentation, animation, and information upgrades.
entries.pattern: Design source pack: frozen artifact snapshot + screenshot + notes + reuse guide + improvement backlog + index references.

entries.component: ExeoFlow YURI OS Switzerland SITREP layer
entries.decision: Expanded the consumer briefing site into a lawful business SITREP by adding an interactive location map, official company contact routes, and per-target action plans. Added 18 Switzerland targets, including national infrastructure operators and local/mid-market businesses for Claudio-led access, while keeping contacts limited to official public company channels.
entries.pattern: Business SITREP layer: abstract geographic map markers -> selected account panel -> official contact route -> 3-step action plan -> public-source guardrail note.

entries.component: ExeoFlow YURI OS target intelligence dashboard
entries.decision: Reworked from light presentation page into dark operator HUD with target profile inspector, scored account rail, evidence/source panels, buying-center hypotheses, discovery questions, and workflow wedges so Claudio can inspect accounts instead of reading generic sector summaries.
entries.pattern: Enterprise target intelligence HUD: left account rail plus central profile inspector plus right buying-center/source panel plus bottom account matrix.

entries.decision: Added the current Nexus Link Productions website as the stronger benchmark reference inside the same ExeoFlow / YURI OS design pack. This gives future iterations a clear comparison target for presentation quality, navigation rhythm, and motion polish instead of treating the SITREP baseline as the standard.
entries.pattern: Two-reference pack: baseline SITREP artifact plus stronger current-site benchmark companion.

entries.decision: Unified design activation around root design-memory.json, installed frontend-design as an active skill, added source-selection and motion-budget rules, and represented the frontier and Framer packs in Design Radar executable catalog form.
entries.pattern: Design task activation pipeline: DESIGN.md -> canonical memory -> frontier atlas -> relevant pack -> implementation constraints -> screenshot/browser verification.
